newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen comfortable with 25 pct EPS growth.
newsitem.headline: Loewen comfortable with 25 pct EPS growth.

text.p: The Loewen Group Inc said on Wednesday it is "quite comfortable" with analysts expectations of 25 percent growth in earnings per share in the near term.

"We are quite comfortable in that 25 percent range going forward. We mustn't worry too much about whether it is 24 or 26," Loewen Chairman and Chief Executive Ray Loewen told analysts on a conference call following the release of the company's fourth-quarter and year-end results.
"Let me put another way, our cash bonuses as senior management are dependent on achieving that 25-percent range," Loewen added.
